containers.name: startup-valuation
containers.dataClass: none (live market data from Yahoo, no store)
containers.notes: Next.js release copied from the node's active slot, run as node server.js with uid 1001. The app has no database and no accounts: /benchmarks and /public-companies read live Yahoo Finance data (revalidated every 5 min) and /api/health probes that dependency. Auth was removed on 2026-11-18, so AUTH_SECRET is not read and need not exist in the slot env. Lean rebuild 2026-10-27: one COPY --chown layer and no .next/cache, 569 MB -> 404 MB. Rolled out by digest through deploy-digest.yml.

containers.name: startup-valuation-api
containers.notes: pylaunch serving api.index:handler on 8021 with --host 0.0.0.0 (it defaults to loopback). The image recreates /usr/bin/python3.12 for the copied venv's console scripts.

containers.name: startup-valuation-calculate
containers.notes: Same image as the API, different entrypoint (api.calculate:handler) on 8020, declared at priority 23 for /api/calculate.
